program_files_etag_length.name: program_files_etag_length
program_files_etag_length.value: "program_files"."etag" is null or char_length("program_files"."etag") between 1 and 200

program_media_dimensions_valid.name: program_media_dimensions_valid
program_media_dimensions_valid.value: ("program_media"."width" is null and "program_media"."height" is null) or ("program_media"."width" is not null and "program_media"."height" is not null and "program_media"."width" > 0 and "program_media"."height" > 0)

programs_card_label_length.name: programs_card_label_length
programs_card_label_length.value: "programs"."card_label" is null or char_length("programs"."card_label") between 1 and 120

programs_headline_length.name: programs_headline_length
programs_headline_length.value: "programs"."headline" is null or char_length("programs"."headline") between 1 and 180

client_checkins_measurements_non_negativ.name: client_checkins_measurements_non_negative
client_checkins_measurements_non_negativ.value:
("client_checkins"."waist_mm" is null or "client_checkins"."waist_mm" >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."hips_mm"  is null or "client_checkins"."hips_mm"  >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."chest_mm" is null or "client_checkins"."chest_mm" >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."neck_mm"  is null or "client_checkins"."neck_mm"  >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."left_arm_mm"    is null or "client_checkins"."left_arm_mm"    >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."right_arm_mm"   is null or "client_checkins"."right_arm_mm"   >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."left_thigh_mm"  is null or "client_checkins"."left_thigh_mm"  >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."right_thigh_mm" is null or "client_checkins"."right_thigh_mm" >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."left_calf_mm"   is null or "client_checkins"."left_calf_mm"   >= 0) and
      ("client_checkins"."right_calf_mm"  is null or "client_checkins"."right_calf_mm"  >= 0)

invoice_credits_reason_valid.name: invoice_credits_reason_valid
invoice_credits_reason_valid.value: ("invoice_credits"."reason" = 'refund' and "invoice_credits"."refund_id" is not null) or ("invoice_credits"."reason" = 'reversal' and "invoice_credits"."refund_id" is null)

invoices_purchase_settlement_present.name: invoices_purchase_settlement_present
invoices_purchase_settlement_present.value: "invoices"."source" <> 'purchase' or ("invoices"."order_id" is not null and "invoices"."settled_payment_id" is not null and "invoices"."status" in ('draft', 'paid') and "invoices"."tax_cents" = 0 and "invoices"."seller_tax_number" is null)

invoices_pdf_r2_fields_together.name: invoices_pdf_r2_fields_together
invoices_pdf_r2_fields_together.value: ("invoices"."pdf_r2_bucket" is null and "invoices"."pdf_r2_object_key" is null) or ("invoices"."pdf_r2_bucket" is not null and "invoices"."pdf_r2_object_key" is not null)

invoices_dates_valid.name: invoices_dates_valid
invoices_dates_valid.value: "invoices"."due_date" is null or "invoices"."issue_date" is null or "invoices"."due_date" >= "invoices"."issue_date"

orders_customer_email_length.name: orders_customer_email_length
orders_customer_email_length.value: "orders"."customer_email" is null or char_length("orders"."customer_email") between 3 and 254

payments_paystack_fields_present.name: payments_paystack_fields_present
payments_paystack_fields_present.value: "payments"."provider" <> 'paystack' or ("payments"."provider_reference" is not null and "payments"."environment" is not null)

payments_checkout_intent_hashes.name: payments_checkout_intent_hashes
payments_checkout_intent_hashes.value: ("payments"."checkout_intent_key_hash" is null and "payments"."checkout_request_hash" is null) or ("payments"."provider" = 'paystack' and "payments"."checkout_intent_key_hash" is not null and "payments"."checkout_intent_key_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "payments"."checkout_request_hash" is not null and "payments"."checkout_request_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

customer_notifications_kind_valid.name: customer_notifications_kind_valid
customer_notifications_kind_valid.value: ("customer_notifications"."kind" = 'purchase' and "customer_notifications"."order_id" is not null) or ("customer_notifications"."kind" = 'login' and "customer_notifications"."order_id" is null)
